fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (SNDK) declined -7.91% following Democratic midterm election victory in 2026 due to investor concerns over government AI regulation, with worries about reduced data center memory chip sales.
fields.summary_ko.1: Citigroup forecasts continued memory chip supply shortage through 2027 (26% demand vs 22% supply growth), with SNDK undervalued at a 5x net profit multiple.
